query: SELECT f.id, f.name, (SELECT count(*) FROM folder_envelopes AS fe JOIN envelopes AS e ON e.account_id = fe.account_id AND e.id = fe.envelope_id WHERE fe.account_id = f.account_id AND fe.folder_id = f.id AND fe.user_id = f.owner_user_id AND e.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "count!" FROM folders AS f WHERE f.account_id = $1 AND f.owner_user_id = $2 AND f.kind = 'envelopes' ORDER BY lower(f.name), f.id
